q: What makes the foramen ovale close functionally at birth?
o: Left atrial pressure rising above right atrial pressure
Clamping of the umbilical vein alone
why: Lung expansion lowers PVR and cord clamping raises SVR, so left atrial pressure exceeds right and pushes the flap closed.

q: Which change does NOT tend to raise pulmonary vascular resistance in a neonate?
why: Hypoxia, hypercapnia, acidosis and cold raise PVR; oxygen and alkalosis lower it.
